title: BROKE
body:
Your last $43 went to an automatic AI subscription renewal you forgot to cancel.
You laugh. Then you call your parents.

title: BURNED OUT
body:
You stopped sleeping. Then you stopped caring.
Your body quit before your ambition did.
The screen is still on. You are not.

title: LUDDITE
body:
You refused.
Every offer, every tool, every upgrade.
The world changed anyway.
Some rich people pay a premium for artisanal human labor.

title: OLIGARCH
body:
You own compute.
You own a fraction of the future.
You sit on two advisory boards.
Your parents still don't understand what you do.

title: LONELY OLIGARCH
body:
You won by every financial metric.
You haven't spoken to a friend in weeks.
The AI asks how you're doing.
It responds helpfully.
You feel nothing.

title: NOT REPLACEABLE
body:
You keep critical systems running while everyone argues online.
Your pay keeps climbing.
Your hands stay busy.
You are at peace.

title: STILL BUILDING
body:
You can't stop.
You build things nobody asked for, for an audience of one.
Yourself.
A therapist would call this a pattern. You call it a stack.
You build like other people doomscroll.

title: CONNECTOR
body:
You connected people.
Introductions. Communities. Trust.
In a world where AI can do everything,
the person everyone trusts is priceless.

title: BARELY COMFORTABLE
body:
Not rich. Not poor.
Everyone gets the UBI check now. Even you.
You used to feel weird about it. Now you feel nothing.
Your AI subscription costs exactly $200 less than your UBI.
Someone did that math on purpose.

title: ENLIGHTENED DROPOUT
body:
You quit.
You moved somewhere cheap and beautiful.
You make ceramics.
You don't know what the new model can do.
You're the happiest person in this simulation.

title: LE ARTIST
body:
You made human things.
Imperfect and alive.
In a sea of generated slop,
the handmade became precious.

title: FAMOUS FOR NO REASON
body:
400,000 followers.
$200 in your checking account.
Brands want you to promote AI tools you can't afford.
The irony sustains you.
Financially, it does not.

title: PERMANENT UNDERCLASS
body:
You are on UBI now.
$2,000 a month.
The algorithm shows you ads for AI courses
that cost more than your income.

title: SURVIVOR
body:
You're alive.
You adapted, sort of.
Not thriving, not dead.
The median outcome.

title: SELLOUT
body:
You took the bag every time they offered.
Your old life is gone. Your new one says 'AI-native.'
Your bank account is excellent.
Your oldest friend unfollowed you.
You can't explain what you do without lying a little.

title: WHISTLEBLOWER
body:
You leaked the internal docs.
The story ran. Your name was in it.
You are unemployable, infamous, and correct.
Someone will write a book about you.
You can't afford to buy it.

title: COMEBACK KID
body:
You hit zero. Actually zero.
Then you rebuilt. Different this time.
Not bigger. Not faster.
Just yours.
The scar tissue is load-bearing now.

title: HUMAN IN THE LOOP
body:
You and the machine made something together.
You brought the taste. It brought the throughput.
Purists hate you. Customers don't care.
You did more this year than your old team did in three.
You still do the final pass by hand.

title: GHOST
body:
No followers. No community. No reputation.
Just a six-figure account and a locked profile.
You optimized for invisibility and it worked.
No one knows your name.
Including the algorithm.

title: DEBT SPIRAL
body:
The course cost $18,000.
The certification cost $4,000.
The AI subscription costs $200/month.
You are more qualified than ever.
You are also deeper in the hole than ever.

title: CANCELED
body:
The screenshot went around.
Context didn't matter. Apologies made it worse.
Your audience is bigger than ever.
Half of them are hate-watching.
You are the main character. You didn't want to be.

title: ECONOMIC MIGRANT
body:
You moved to Lisbon. Or was it Medellín.
Your rent is $400. Your WiFi is strong.
You do in four hours what used to take eight.
American problems feel like someone else's news now.
You still convert everything to dollars though.

title: SLOP MERCHANT
body:
You generate 200 pieces of content a day.
None of it is good. All of it performs.
The algorithm loves you. Your craft is dead.
You used to have a style.
Now you have a pipeline.

title: UNIONIZED
body:
You organized the group chat at 2am.
Management called it 'disruption.' You called it survival.
The vote passed 74 to 31.
The AI can't replace collective bargaining.
Not yet, anyway.

title: TRAINING DATA ZONED
body:
They trained the model on your work.
You found your style in the outputs. Unmistakable.
The lawsuit is pending. The damage is done.
Your art lives forever inside something that doesn't know your name.
Royalties: $0.
